Class NodeExplanationList

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.LinkedList<Explanation>
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.NodeExplanationList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Explanation>
public class NodeExplanationList extends LinkedList<Explanation>
A collection of explanations associated with a specific node. Every node in this collection has the associated node as its node.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
